item.title: Telegram gifts are the only NFTs still alive. 📈 They are up 2.5x since issuance…
item.description: Telegram gifts are the only NFTs still alive. 📈 They are up 2.5x since issuance 1–2 years ago, despite crypto winter. This week, P2P gift trading on Telegram moved on-chain: — Sales & offers run on smart contracts. — Grams go instantly to sellers' wallets. — Fees cut from 10% to 2% 🎉
